node.title: Re^3: Is there any way to put regex modifiers into a variable?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
the /o modifier

Although I'm having trouble finding it at the moment, I think there was some recent discussion that /o is often not what you want. All I found so far is [id://269035], although that's not recent. There's the FAQ [doc://perlfaq6#What-is-/o-really-for?]. You could perhaps look into [doc://perlretut#Compiling-and-saving-regular-expressions|qr//].
